group_assessment.weighting: National medical-genetics research centre; single case report of whole-chromosome-16 isodisomy studied with microarray, microsatellites, FISH, exome, trio genome and trio nanopore methylation. No WWOX-focused work; WWOX appears only as a cited example of a recessive gene unmasked by chromosome-16 isodisomy.

field_density.note: Two PubMed records pair WWOX with uniparental disomy; this case report is a third paper naming the route, by citation only.

queued.why: Reference 16, the only WWOX-direct reference: the primary report of a homozygous WWOX canonical-donor allele made homozygous by chromosome-16 isodisomy. No PMCID; Europe PMC search returns no full text; Unpaywall oa_status closed on 2026-10-04. FT-135 already carries this PMID as declared debt; this reading adds a second citing paper to the same address rather than minting a new one.

multihop.note: 57 references enumerated from the JATS back matter; one is WWOX-direct (reference 16). It is paywalled with no lawful free route from this host, so the hop is queued, not resolved, and this reading is declared partial for that reason alone.

entries.proposition: The authors list WWOX among recessive genes whose disease has been unmasked by chromosome-16 uniparental disomy, citing one WWOX reference.
entries.snippet: GAN [15], and WWOX [16] within the UPD

entries.proposition: Isodisomy makes homologous chromosome-16 loci identical, so a recessive allele can be unmasked; WWOX is named as an example, by citation.
entries.snippet: associated phenotypes may be due to unmasked mutations in recessive disease-related genes like GPT2

entries.proposition: The authors name the usual origin of isodisomy as monosomy rescue, as opposed to trisomy rescue for heterodisomy.
entries.snippet: Another pathomechanism of UPD (16) is monosomy 16 rescue, where most cases are isodisomic (UPiD)

entries.proposition: In this index case, exome sequencing found no unmasked pathogenic recessive variant anywhere on chromosome 16, WWOX included: the patient's WWOX is homozygous by isodisomy and carries no reported pathogenic allele.
entries.snippet: No unmasked pathogenic recessive genetic variants on chromosome 16 were detected

entries.proposition: The copy-neutral LOH spans chromosome 16 end to end, and the microarray panel shows two LOH segments covering both arms.
Cases whose phenotype is explained by an unmasked recessive allele (the WWOX case among them) were excluded from the authors' phenotype comparison table, so Table 1 carries no WWOX case.
entries.snippet: excluding patients with either an effect of mutations of autosomal recessive genes
